notes: 签名工具导入改版：下线系统分享面板（拆包定案轻松签/全能签无分享扩展，分享面板里永远不出现）；「用其他应用打开」成为签名工具首选入口；全能签用户推荐「保存到文件」后在其内导入
notesEn: Signing-tool import rework: removed the system share sheet (neither ESign nor UniversalSign has a share extension); 'Open in Another App' is now the primary path; UniversalSign users should use 'Save to Files' then import inside the app.
